description: This is a Java source file defining a wallpaper service for Android, including an inner Engine class that manages drawing a moving circle with changing colors and handling user touch events.

classes.name: SampleWallpaper
classes.description: Main class extending WallpaperService that creates and manages the wallpaper engine.

classes.name: SampleWallpaper.MySampleEngine
classes.description: Inner class extending WallpaperService.Engine, responsible for rendering the animated wallpaper, handling display updates, touch events, and drawing visuals.

methods.name: onCreateEngine
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the inner Engine class for wallpaper rendering.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes display parameters, paint, and starts drawing when engine is created.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Unregisters display listener to clean up resources.

methods.name: onComputeColors
methods.description: Provides dynamic wallpaper colors based on current background color.

methods.name: onVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Starts or stops the drawing loop depending on wallpaper visibility.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles user touch events to reposition the animated circle and invert direction.

methods.name: onSurfaceDestroyed
methods.description: Stops animation when surface is destroyed.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Performs drawing of background, tip image, text, and animated circle; schedules next frame.

methods.name: invertCircleDirectionIfNeeded
methods.description: Reverses circle movement direction if it moves outside display bounds and triggers color updates.

methods.name: updateShift
methods.description: Updates circle position based on shift vectors and radii.

methods.name: genNewShift
methods.description: Generates new random shift values for circle movement.

methods.name: genNewColor
methods.description: Generates new random colors for background and paint with contrast considerations.

methods.name: initDisplay
methods.description: Initializes display object and registers display change listener.

methods.name: updateDisplay
methods.description: Refreshes display metrics, updates circle starting position, loads tip image, and calculates text bounds.

methods.name: initPaint
methods.description: Configures paint object for anti-aliasing, stroke width, and text size.
